milestone: P1 - Real Data Foundation + First Exact Validation Case Investigation

blocking_summary.primary_blocker: Authoritative temporal boundary mismatch for gridded rainfall (00Z->24Z vs 03Z->03Z) and institutional access controls / paid procurement for historical station observations (IMD DSP / Bharatkosh).
blocking_summary.missing_source_access: Unauthenticated, programmatic historical IMD SYNOP/surface observation archive for pre-2026 forecast cycles.
blocking_summary.scientific_honesty_commitment: ForecastGuard strictly refuses to match the 00Z->24Z NCMRWF TIGGE rainfall step with the 03Z->03Z IMD observation window, refuses to fabricate synthetic observations, and refuses to bypass governmental licensing/paywalls.

1_imd_synop_surface_observations.authority: IMD National Data Centre (NDC) Pune (dsp.imdpune.gov.in / cdsp.imdpune.gov.in)
1_imd_synop_surface_observations.finding: Historical station-level SYNOP observations require formal user registration, government identity verification, Certificate of Undertaking, and paid procurement via Bharatkosh (NTRP) portal. No public unauthenticated download API exists.

2_imd_wis2box.temporal_retention: Operational rolling buffer (~3-4 months: June 2026 to September 2026). Pre-2026 historical archives (2024, 2025) return 0 features.
2_imd_wis2box.tigge_overlap: NCMRWF TIGGE on ECMWF MARS returns MarsNoDataError for 2026 cycles.

3_imd_gridded_daily_rainfall_2024.temporal_window: 03:00 UTC (day D-1) to 03:00 UTC (day D) [08:30 IST to 08:30 IST]
3_imd_gridded_daily_rainfall_2024.tigge_compatibility: INCOMPATIBLE. NCMRWF TIGGE forecast steps are 6-hourly (00Z, 06Z, 12Z, 18Z, 24Z). Steps +3h and +27h do not exist. 3-hour temporal offset violates Non-Negotiable Rule 7.

4_imd_gridded_daily_temperature_2024.finding: Provides daily extremes (Tmax, Tmin) rather than instantaneous 2m temperature at forecast valid UTC.

ncmrwf_tigge_forecast.source: ECDS / ECMWF MARS (dataset: tigge-forecasts, class: ti, origin: dems)
